reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text:
There’s not much to it unless you pay for the subscription which is more than 100 annually. It’s not worth it. The only thing it really has to offer is the pretty graphics it provides and the fact that it’s easily accessible since it’s an app. But for the most part it’s straight up a gimmick and basic info you can get for free. Do the 3 day trial and see for yourself. You’ll be paying over $100 for an app you’ll either get bored of quickly or won’t really benefit from very much. You can get a detailed horoscope reading and natal charts from many websites online for free or for way way cheaper. Save your money. Note: I read many of the comments/reviews for the app and the developer is great at responding however; they keep apologizing for typos or things not working correctly by saying they’re actively working on fixing these errors and they underestimated the time it would take to include some things (these are just examples). That’s a problem because, again, you’re being charged over $100 for an app that isn’t even complete or working the way it “should be”. This is $50 dollars more than your average video game, or streaming subscription. It is straight up a rip off and they know it. They push the yearly subscription yet claim they have so much to offer for free, they need to realize that their app is not worth $100.

Also a lot of the reviews on here seem to be bots/falsified. I see more negative reviews than positive ones yet they have 4+ rating. Doesn’t make sense.

reviews.title: Good for daily horoscope, but readings feel rooted in greed.
reviews.text: This app is very well made, and it is great for the daily horoscope and other information like your birth charts and much more information about you. However, I feel as if the prices for the readings are rooted in greed, and the paywall would be best for those making $100,000 per year or more. You get 3 minutes for free then every minute is 30-60 pts. 10 points is the equivalent of $1. So a ten minute conversation by text will cost you roughly $30. Not to mention the reading people will be on and off the conversation sometimes so you are occasionally paying while they are talking to someone else. This is definitely a critical issue. They need to rearrange the app to where you can schedule a 15ish minute reading for a reasonable price and have the reader exclusively. Some readers go up to 60 pts or $6 dollars a minute. I have local readings at a place that charges about $70 for 30 minutes. So I certainly feel like the prices on the app are quite excessive in my opinion. They are also basically sales people as random readers text me in the app every day to chat with them for money per minute. Decent app but a minute goes by instantly and it can take 2 minutes for them to even respond or look at your question.

reviews.title: This app is a scam

Second, the app also makes you answer all these buzz feed quiz style questions and take a picture of your hand for a “palm reading” during the setup phase but never gives you the results of that.

But here’s the kicker: it initially tells you what the actual price is but if you can’t afford that, it gives you other prices you could pay including $1. I chose the $1 option because I couldn’t afford to pay full price nor do I want to before I’ve even seen the results. I ultimately decided the app wasn’t worth it so I deleted it. So I blocked the charge and redownloaded the app and had to play around in settings for 10 minutes before I found the “how to check for active subscriptions” button  and entered in my email and discovered that the app had, in fact, signed me up for a subscription that I didn’t want. Nebula acknowledges this delicate balance. It doesn't claim to have all the answers, but it encourages introspection. Rather than spoon-feeding predictions, it nudges you to consider possibilities. And that's where the magic lies—when you blend cosmic wisdom with your own discernment. Nebula doesn't promise to change your fate overnight. Instead, it reminds us that we're the architects of our destiny. The planets may influence, but our choices steer the ship. It's like having a celestial GPS—guidance without coercion. So, yes, Nebula offers insights, but it also empowers us to take charge. Beyond the charts and interpretations, Nebula fosters a sense of community. Connecting with like-minded souls, sharing experiences, and learning from one another—it's a cosmic coffee shop where the universe serves wisdom in every cup. In a world where noise often drowns out whispers of the stars, Nebula stands out. It's not about blind faith; it's about embracing the mystery. So, whether you're navigating life's storms or basking in its sunsets, Nebula is a worthy companion—one that encourages growth, reflection, and stargazing.

reviews.text: It is an amazing app as far as the chart, advise, and reading aspect of it goes and I would give that part alone a 5 star rating but I simply can’t with the social media side included in the calculation of my opinion on the app. It’s just insanely hard to navigate. I think you should have a notification box set-up to make it easier to see responses to your comments and comments on your post. I also think you should be able to click on someone’s profile and see their other posts. Finally, I think you should be able to search (by key word) for people and posts. reviews.title: Absolutely hilarious

reviews.title: I expected answers not judgmental
reviews.text:
I’m very disappointed with this app. Some of the people on here are genuinely nice and helpful, but unfortunately, some are not.

One of my biggest issues happened when my account somehow got deleted. When I tried logging back in with the same information, it created a whole new account. Then I was questioned about why I supposedly had “a whole bunch of accounts.” I didn’t intentionally create multiple accounts—my original account was deleted, and trying to log back in created another one.

I was also criticized for asking the same or similar questions. Sometimes people repeat a question because they’re desperate for clarity, reassurance, or a better understanding of what they’re going through. That doesn’t mean they should be judged or treated badly.

After my experience, I personally don’t feel like this app is worth spending money on when you’re looking for answers. I’ve spent time on here hoping for genuine guidance, and instead I’ve walked away feeling disappointed and questioning whether the service is trustworthy.

At this point, I would rather go somewhere in person, such as Cassadaga, and speak with someone face-to-face. In my experience there, you don’t necessarily have to keep asking question after question—they can simply tell you what they feel or pick up on.

This is just my personal experience and opinion, but I feel like I wasted my time and money on this app. I expected a much better experience, and unfortunately, I’m leaving very disappointed.

reviews.title: Scam Warning!!!
reviews.text: I signed up for the free trial and afterwards I had a very very hard time finding where to cancel through their website. By the time I found it they had already charged me 45$ and yet when I looked at my account it said “subscription not active” I contacted them through their help desk, there’s no phone number to call. They replied through email saying they would refund my money if I told them which card I used and showed my Pay Pal information proving that I paid and what was charged. I responded and gave them all the information plus the screenshot showing that there was no active subscription and I have not heard from them again since. Now, I have to go through my Pay Pal and card companies to see if one of them can reverse or cancel the charges. I’m low income and can’t afford 45$ but they intentionally make it hard to find exactly where to look for cancelling for one thing and even when you don’t have an active subscription it seems they charge you anyway. Beware!! I shouldn’t have been so stupid to fall for their scheme. Please don’t fall for it either.

reviews.title: Colossal waste of time

reviews.title: Palm reading AMAZING!!!!

reviews.title: Love the insight but…
reviews.text:
As freakily accurate as the chart is, I am just now discovering there are various many other things that are taken into account—like your Pallas Sign among one…

reviews.title: A truly great app.
reviews.text:
Not only is this app crazy accurate, but it provides education on everything you would want to know about astrology, birth and gemstones, your birth time, palm reading, etc. though it has an option to pay to unlock the lessons, you are also able to watch an add to unlock them, as well! So, if your a bit tight on funds, there’s still an option to educate yourself! 

I love the fact of when you are setting the app up to your customization, it asks more than just your name and birth date, with the little bit of extra information you provide of what time you were born and where, it is able to open up so much more of your personal chart. I’ve learned quite a few new things about myself with this app that I didn’t realize before and I’ve been going through the lessons to learn more about them all. I highly recommend this app. If you were debating, just download it and try it out for yourself. reviews.text: I’ll admit this app has surprised me on how accurate it is, I’ll say sometimes it’s a few days off. reviews.title: Greedy.
reviews.text: I downloaded this app back in 2020 and absolutely loved it. It was leagues ahead of its competitors. I dealt with the ads for the weekly/monthly/yearly subscription and wasn’t too annoyed. Fast forward to now… I can’t even read my birth chart without paying? reviews.title: Free Trial Fraud at Its Most Shameless
reviews.text:
This app offers a measly 3-day trial, which I naturally signed up for to see what the app had to offer—only to find that most features are still barred from usage unless you pay an additional fee for each specific component. A feature as simple as a birth chart reading requires a $20 payment. It even has a tab labeled "Free," which shows the limited content you’re relegated to.

So, it seems like the “trial” wasn’t free at all—just a blatant ploy to get users to sign up in hopes they forget to cancel in time. At least other apps usually have the decency to unlock full premium access for a few minutes during the trial period. I can’t even imagine what the basic version of this app is like, and frankly, I don’t even want to check out what’s available. I’m completely put off by such brazen greed—and that’s saying a lot, considering most apps nowadays are pay-to-click by default.

reviews.title: Surprisingly Insightful & Addictive
reviews.text:
I honestly didn’t expect to enjoy Nebula this much, but it’s become one of my favorite apps. The readings are detailed, thoughtful, and actually feel personalized instead of generic copy-and-paste astrology. Whether it’s birth charts, compatibility insights, or daily guidance, everything is explained in a way that’s easy to understand but still deep.

The app layout is clean and user-friendly, the visuals are calming, and the content feels intentional. It’s perfect whether you’re just curious about astrology or already deep into it. I also like that it doesn’t feel pushy or gimmicky like some similar apps.

Overall, Nebula feels well-designed, engaging, and genuinely helpful. Definitely worth downloading if you’re into self-reflection, astrology, or just want a little guidance and fun insight added to your day

reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text:
I am somewhat suspicious of horoscopes and the related arts. I was into them as a teenager. But, then I realized that they are written in such a way as they can be applied broadly and many different types of people will see themselves in them. 

However, that said, your interpretation seems to be pretty close. You mention my artistic nature, my love of creating beauty and that is certainly true. Unlike other members of my family, I am very interested in how things look around me, and spend a lot of time decorating and organizing my environment. I also used to write creatively, draw and paint when I was younger and I would like to get back to myself. 

You also spend a lot of time talking about drawing on my experiences, my intelligence and my ability to think critically which I do believe to be true. You said my 4th decade, which is odd because I just started my fifth. But, I feel like I have packed a whole lot of experiences into those years. I also am college educated, and try to sort through information to reach a logical conclusion. 

Yet, you also talk about leading with my heart, which I am afraid I am often too prone to doing. 

Overall, it seemed a good and accurate reading. But, not sure why you said 4th decade when I know I gave you my birthdate. I’m turning 51 in April.

reviews.title: More than expected
reviews.text:
I wasn’t expecting to love Nebula as much as I do, but wow—it really surprised me. The content feels intentional and refreshing, like it’s actually made for people who are tired of the same recycled stuff everywhere else. You can tell the creators genuinely care about what they’re putting out, and it shows in the quality.

What I appreciate most is how it feels more personal and less crowded. No constant interruptions, no overwhelming noise—just solid, engaging videos that you actually want to sit and watch. It’s the kind of platform you open when you want something meaningful, not just background scrolling.

Definitely worth it if you enjoy thoughtful content and want to support creators doing their thing without all the clutter. Easy 5 stars from me.

reviews.title: Do NOT GET THIS
reviews.text: First of all, they say “money back guarntee” but not if you “didn’t know there was a subscription” and “did not like the product”. Literally the only two reasons people ask for a refund. And the subscription is not through the App Store so you cannot cancel unless you email them directly. If you like the product and it’s worth $45 a month for you, good for you. This is definitely not worth $45 for me. This is basically a scam. Spend your money on an actual tarot reader. They just want your money and won’t give you a refund even though it’s “money back guarantee” READ THE FINE PRINT. Set an alarm. In this economy, $45 is nothing to play with. Especially since I can go buy a shirt from a store for $45 and if I don’t like it I can return it. I don’t want this product, couldn’t find the cancellation so didn’t know I had a subscription and now they won’t give me a refund because the fine print of their “money back guarentee” is that you actually won’t get your money back. I would give 0 stars if I could.

reviews.title: It’s okay I guess
reviews.text:
Right off the bat I’m going to say I’m eleven. I downloaded this app because I think zodiac stuff is interesting. So as I was setting it up and got to the part where you select your birthday, I noticed if you use 2010, 2011, 2012 etc, it would automatically go to 2009. I do not know if it was programmed this way or if it’s an error. I was really disappointed with this. I believe the app should let people use any age they would like, whether it’s for their children, a friend or just anyone, because zodiac stuff is super fun! Even though it isn’t always quite accurate. I hope that people will be able to use ages younger than thirteen in the future with this app :/ — btw I believe this is a great app, again, I’m a bit upset that you aren’t able to use ages under thirteen 😕

Response to developer:
Okay, that makes sense. I would be looking up to the update if it comes out! 
Thank you for letting me know.

reviews.title: It was great until
reviews.text: The ads for one downloadable feature or stickers or something arbitrary one day became pop up annoyances, I can handle the typical pop up ad window and watch some bs clip of some bs product I’m never gonna consider buying a couple dozen times a day, without question, I’ve even enjoyed a service enough to shockingly pay to subscribe and turn off ads as a side effect of the other membership benefits one appreciates. As mentioned this app was enjoyable and consideration to become a member would have easily lean in the affirmative, yet one particular ad was presented, closed and presented again like five seconds later, closed in an effort to glean the insight that I was accustomed to understanding daily and before the sentence content could be determined the ad reappeared again, a different ad may have been less frustrating, but the same ad like a dozen times in a row, no shirt, was frustratingly annoying enough to compel me to share my encounter with the strange uncle and the bad touches I felt. I hope one day it will reconsider recent alterations and restore a user.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: I never write reviews for apps but this one really sticks out to warn people not to download. It used to be okay when I had it a couple years ago. I recently downloaded it again and boy is it sad how much of weak cash grab it’s become. While before it had a quite a few free features you MUST have a subscription at 7.99/months. Okay fine. Plenty of apps cost money. But that must mean it’s good right? Nope. The subscription only includes very few features such as basic comparability reports based on your zodiac signs. It asks your sub, noon, and ascendant and then gives you a report based mentioning nothing but sun signs. Any horoscope site can tell you that. Most other features cost money including $20/per to reveal answers to personality quizzes to find out things like spirit animal or witch type. I doubt they’re accurate but wouldn’t know as shelling out $27 for this kind of service would mean I have officially lost my mind entirely. The money you scam out of other people will be repaid by forces of evil .

reviews.title: My horoscope still says August and it’s the middle of September
reviews.text: I just bought this app no more than a minute ago and was going through everything. I swiped over to the month horoscope and it says August for two of the categorizes. It’s in “love and relationships” and “health.” I kinda seems to me they just copy and paste and forgot to switch the months. I still have a trial and will probably be cancelling. I don’t know enough about the app yet but it dosent seem very genuine to me. I also tried to find a customer service email address so I wouldn’t have to post a review. reviews.title: Accurate, informative, and detailed
reviews.text:

reviews.title: Wow, this is left me speechless first time in my life so glad I gave this a chance
reviews.text: Absolutely take the opportunity to explore this app. Totally spot on. reviews.title: Deceptive dealings
reviews.text: I can’t say that I have tried the app to know if it’s truly great or not. I signed up to get the 3 day free before beginning a subscription. However.. after thinking that’s what I purchased I learned they billed me $52 for a yearly subscription. When I contacted the company to explain what happened…they basically told me to pay more attention and explained why I should keep the app. If this were a situation where I misread I would have. However….the option I believe I selected was highlighted. I use and iPhone and when I make a purchase I’m asked to confirm it…even when it is a trial. That did not happen here. So you don’t know what you truly purchased until you get the bill. Now I will never sign up for anything with this company again.  Once I did use the app…after 3 minutes I was asked to pay for something else. I have an app that provides horóscopos…I wouldn’t have paid for another. reviews.title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS APP
reviews.text: This has been by far the worst experience I have ever had with an app. This app drained for than $25 from my account in SECONDS due to a technical failure. When I tried to get assistance for the situation the customer service team sent me through a loop asking for countless screenshots which I provided, I continuously asked for updates and they would only ask for more personal information, including a screenshot of my phones details. You'll regret it, I promise.

reviews.title: Waste of time and $$$
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app thinking it would be worth wild, however, I was sadly mistaken. I’m a HUGE astrology enthusiast who has already done most research into my birth chart. After seeing an ad for the app I thought, “WTH why not give it a shot.” When it comes down to it this app has a lot of work to do to not only for convenience but also functionally. 

After downloading the app the first thing that rubbed me wrong was the amount of times I was asked to subscribe (sign-up for a membership). The first time I was prompted I didn’t know it was optional until I noticed the X (close button) in the top right corner. However, after closing the subscription screen I was prompted several more times to subscribe in order to do almost anything on the app. The basic functions of the app are horoscopes and your personal birth chart, which are free. These can pretty much be found on ANY website for free and are just as accurate if not better on other websites.  

Secondly, I noticed that I accidentally put in the wrong birth time. When trying to correct this mistake I realized that there was no way to correct it or at the very least it is very difficult to find.

Overall, in my opinion this app is not worth the time nor amount of $$$ for the features. The only thing I like about this app is the features it has such as the palmistry, however, you need to subscribe for $119 (annual) or 9.99 (monthly) to be able to access many or these features.

reviews.title: App fromReal user
reviews.text: I’m giving us a three star because when you sign up you do get a 38 page report for free, the app does do what it says it does, I removed stars because it is not intuitive on how to cancel the subscription. But I will say that the customer service was friendly and prompt, and the people out there that are giving it one star and calling it a scam, aren’t really being fair. Yes, this is a subscription service and it says that when you sign up. As far as people not getting refunds, no they do not give refunds just because you forgot to cancel your subscription, that’s on you. I didn’t like this app as much as I like costar, which is why I canceled, not because of the fees. It was easy to cancel, I just sent an email and said please cancel my subscription and in less than one day I had a response letting me know that my subscription is canceled. From a real user 👍

reviews.title: I really enjoy this app!
reviews.text: This app is very detailed and specific to you! It changes often offering new features and different insights. It has beautiful images and it reads in a way that is easy to understand for people who are new to charts , energies and such. The only reason idn give it 5 stars is because there is paywalls behind features even after paying the subscription fee. There is also a large price margin between weekly and yearly. I know it isn’t free to operate nor should it be with the level of services available. But I do think with the price difference from weekly to yearly that there is a more affordable price for people that may not have the yearly cost. With that caveat over all I do like this app and would recommend it to anyone that is interested in spiritual growth and self reflection.

reviews.title: Great, but 1 flaw
reviews.text:
I like this app, it’s do accurate it’s kinda scary 😅 
so my only concern is the app doesn’t have the Cusp information in here, the zodiac information is extremely accurate, however I would love the option to view information for my Cusp as well, it took my mom to point out that I even was a Cusp & I came to realize after looking at both of the Zodiac charts that represent me, I’m indeed connected to both Aquarius & Pisces, with Pisces being my technical main I guess 🤔 anyways, I’ll update my review for 4 stars to 5 stars if the developers ever add the option to view Cusps, aside from that 1 downside & ofc the crazy amount of $$$ it takes to talk to someone on here, it’s a very amazing app & extremely informative, I just ask for 1 extra bit of information which is the Cusps, that’s all I really ask for honestly 😅

reviews.title: Great compatibility reading!
reviews.text: Ok so here’s my honest review. I went ahead and spent a dollar on a trial to get a compatibility report with the girl. I’m headed over heels in love with. That report seems pretty grounded, accurate and appropriate to me, but it came with 33 minutes of a psychic reading as soon as the three minutes started I felt pressured to get all my information out before they asked me for more money, which of course happened right at the moment when I was hoping to get an answer, the screen to you build me comes up. reviews.title: Charges are ridiculous.
reviews.text:
$10 a WEEK for the same features is ridiculous. Then anything else in the app costs more money on top of that, and is not clearly explained until you put in all the info and it finally tells you the cost. 

Not to mention- the very first time I did the compatibility, an option to get a more specific report was in a box on the screen within the description. When I put in all the info, the app alerted me that I would receive an email by 11am the next day. I did not, and reached out to the support wondering why. When I went to cancel the subscription, there are roughly 20 different pricing options and the cancel option. How was my pricing determined? Needs work- onboarding would make a huge difference, and being upfront with cost as well.

reviews.title: Insightful
reviews.text: I’ve subscribed to Nebula on and off over the past couple years. When I’ve had to cancel it, it was due to my own financial situation at the time. I should also note that their customer service was beyond helpful and kind to me when I needed to cancel and they will absolutely go above and beyond to assist you! There are so many different areas to explore in this app and so much you can learn about yourself. They also have a space where you can go within the app to get a reading done, if that’s something you’re into. I’ve personally had 2 readings done since I joined Nebula and both of them were spot on! I would highly recommend this app to anyone considering downloading it. I promise you will not regret it!

reviews.title: Nebula experience
reviews.text: Today was my first reading with this app. Overall I am very pleased with my reading. Some down falls were the constant interruptions for payment. This by no means is a reflection of my reading but totally app issue. Someone who is in the middle of a conversation has to stop, make payment and return to the conversation can be annoying as we are there to discuss our concerns that we desperately are seeking guidance on. Understandable payment is needed however there should be another way to obtain without discord of our meeting. My person was amazing and knew what I was dealing with unfortunately after $100 I didn’t get all my answers but the one question I wanted she was able to verify and to me that was what I needed to hear today.

reviews.title: Sad I Have to Uninstall
reviews.text: It’s kind of sad that I’m writing this review because I’ve been an user with Nebula for over 3 years now and everytime I get on there to check my birth chart, it seems like it’s always something. reviews.title: Careful, Subscriptions appear automatically!

reviews.title: PLEASE READ THE REVIEWS ABOUT BEING CHARGED!
reviews.text:
These guys are good! reviews.title: Great concept, weird notifications
reviews.text: I got this app because my boyfriend got it and suggested it to me. At first, I was happy to find an app that was accurate and gave me more information than other astrology apps. Over time, it started sending me at least 3-5 notifications a day and the WORST PART was that they all said something along the lines of “Talk to an astrologer—find out when you will get married” or “Find out when you’ll have kids”. My boyfriend hasn’t received a single notification like this (about marriage and kids). I am not even near the average age that people have children and got so fed up with these notifications that I deleted the app. I also didn’t enjoy the interface and noticed quite a few grammatical errors, but this wouldn’t have made me stop using the app if it wasn’t sending me misogynistic notifications all day about personal life events that I don’t even care for at the moment.

reviews.title: Subscription Payment Issues
reviews.text: I had the service for multiple months. Last month, after I was charged, I went into my account and thought I had successfully cancelled my subscription. Somehow it didn’t go through and I was charged again this month. I immediately contacted support stating what had happened and asking simply for the current month’s refund as it had been a day, if that, since it was charged. I received a curt response about how my subscription was cancelled finally but that i understood charges at the time of the quiz. Which yes, I did, but most companies will refund within in a few days of the charges due to the various reasons subscriptions can be cancelled/renewed and their issues. They won’t. I won’t be renewing even though I thought about it in a month or so when our family finances are better. Long story short, make sure you get confirmation on subscription changes, because their customer support is no help.

reviews.title: Repetitive
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for some years now and have actually found it to be insightful. However, as of late I’ve noticed that my daily readings are all the same, just switched up a bit. Like using the same exact wording from Thursday’s horoscope on Friday, just in different placements, but all the same message. This is interesting because in the past, they would feel more personalized and not generic. I wonder if this is because of an incorporation with Ai, but for me at least, the app has lost its appeal in terms of daily horoscopes, and I would much rather read the generic daily sign horoscopes instead since they have the same affect at this point. 

Other aspects of the app I still like, but my primary use was for the daily readings and now I just don’t find them to be as interesting. (Not necessarily the content, but the repetitiveness).
